links.targetTitle: Any SKY holder can force review of an Agent Artifact conflic

title: Ecosystem Accord disputes run a timeboxed adversarial pipeline with a frivolousness screen at intake
content:
The process in A.2.8.1.1.2 gives every step a deadline. A.2.8.1.1.2.1.2 has Core GovOps make "a brief preliminary determination regarding whether the request is reasonable (i.e. not vexatious or frivolous), within three (3) working days." If not reasonable, A.2.8.1.1.2.1.3 ends it there with reasons and "no further action." If reasonable, A.2.8.1.1.2.1.4 requires notifying all parties with an outline of "the process to be followed, including relevant steps and timeframes."

The argument phase is a conventional three-round exchange: five working days for the initiator's Statement of Problem, five for the other side's Statement of Response, three for the initiator's Statement of Rebuttal (A.2.8.1.1.2.2.1 through .3). A.2.8.1.1.2.3.2 then gives the Core Facilitator three working days to decide.

Two design choices stand out. The **screen comes first and is cheap** — three days of one party's attention disposes of a bad-faith claim before anyone else is drawn in, which is what makes a low-friction right to request dispute resolution safe to grant.

And the **rebuttal is shorter than the opening statements**, deliberately closing the exchange rather than inviting escalation. The initiator gets the last word but a constrained one; there is no sur-rebuttal, so the record is finite by construction.

Running a full adjudication in under a month matters for commercial agreements between Primes, where an unresolved dispute freezes capital deployment. The trade is depth: complex factual disagreements get five days of preparation, which is why A.2.8.1.1.2.3.1 requires Core GovOps to flag "areas of factual ambiguity" rather than pretend the record is complete.
description: Three working days to judge reasonableness, then five for the Statement of Problem, five for the Response, three for the Rebuttal and three for the decision — roughly nineteen working days end to end.
